headers.comment: Staging: keep the preview out of search indexes. Remove this block when (and only when) this becomes the public production site.
Page relies on inline scripts/styles, Google Fonts, and data: URI icons. Verify on first deploy and loosen any directive that blocks a needed resource.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
